result.brief: 提出 Delta-LTM 预测动作引起的潜特征增量而非直接预测下一潜状态，并用交互感知潜对齐监督交互相关变化，提升机器人操作的长时程动作条件视频预测物理一致性。
result.reason: Action-conditioned latent world simulator for robot manipulation; predicts latent increments with interaction-aware latent alignment, a representation-level contribution to video world models.
